an10.108:1.1: Tikicchakā bhikkhave virecanaṃ denti pittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ pi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya semhasamuṭṭhānānam pi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya vātasamuṭṭhānānam pi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an10.108:1.2: Atth' etaṃ bhikkhave virecanaṃ, n' etaṃ natthī ti vadāmi.
an10.108:1.3: Tañ ca kho etaṃ bhikkhave virecanaṃ sampajjati pi vipajjati pi.
an10.108:2.1: Ahañ ca kho bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ desissāmi, yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjati yeva no vipajjati; yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.108:2.2: Taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī ti.
an10.108:2.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.108:3.1: Katamañ ca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ, yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjati yeva no vipajjati; yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti, jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti? 3.
an10.108:4.2: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c' assa virittā honti,
an10.108:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.108:6.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c' assa virittā honti,
an10.108:6.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti. 4.
an10.108:6.4: Idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ, yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjati yeva no vipajjati; yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti, maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantī
